title: Police to train teachers, social workers on youth gang involvement
summary: Police will train teachers and social workers to identify signs of youth gang involvement. A new program aims to help young people exit gangs and rebuild their lives. Separately, an inquiry was told that gun clubs should be trained to detect radicalisation among members who might commit violent acts. A shooting organisation official and a psychologist made this recommendation.
summary_points: Police will train teachers and social workers to identify signs of youth gang involvement.
A new program will assist young people in leaving gangs and reintegrating into society.
An inquiry heard recommendations for gun clubs to be trained to detect radicalisation.
The recommendation for gun clubs was made by a shooting organisation official and a psychologist.
